purpose: Trigger and near-miss prompts: run after any description change; record results in evals/results.md separately from behavioural cases.
should_trigger: Design the WAN for 40 remote sites on satellite with LTE backup and tell me what fails first.
We are moving from OSPF to eBGP in the datacenter fabric; what is the migration plan?
Two offices both use 10.20.0.0/16 and now need a site-to-site tunnel. Options?
Plan IPv6 addressing for a campus with 30 buildings and guest Wi-Fi.
Our VXLAN overlay drops large packets after we added WireGuard between sites. Why?
Will a 12 km 5.8 GHz point-to-point link with 23 dBi dishes close with 15 dB of margin?
Segment the OT network from corporate users without breaking the historian.
Is our dual-ISP edge actually redundant? Both circuits enter in the same duct.
Design DNS, DHCP and NTP so remote sites keep working when the WAN is down.
Review this firewall and VLAN design for the new warehouse before we order switches.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Show the RouterOS command to print interface link-downs on the site switch.
What does the ansible-wifi report column 'tstik_reset' mean?
Which firmware is current for the Cambium ePMP 3000 SM?
Lay out this draw.io diagram so the arrows stop crossing.
Add a custom field to Nautobot devices for circuit IDs.
Why is OpenWISP not receiving metrics from this device?
Write a Python function that parses this CSV of interfaces.
Size the Proxmox cluster memory so it survives losing one host.
How long will a 2 TB restore take over our backup link?
Write a cover letter for a network engineer role.
